long_biography.plain_text:
Leading the take-private of WuXi PharmaTech made Fan "Frank" Yu's Ally Bridge Group a visible force in global life-sciences investing. The deal reflected his model of connecting Chinese healthcare platforms with American and European capital, technology and public markets. His first investment as a fund manager had been Shenzhen cardiovascular-device maker LifeTech Scientific, giving the approach an early clinical-technology focus.

Yu founded Ally Bridge after nearly a decade at Goldman Sachs in Hong Kong and a senior China-investing role at Och-Ziff. He developed the firm across venture, growth, buyout and public-equity strategies, directing capital towards medical technology, biotechnology, diagnostics and digital health. Beyond investment management, he serves as a Solomon R. Guggenheim Foundation trustee and supports business education at Queens College, where he studied economics and applied mathematics.
